answers.ask: No art direction was given - should this read as bright stylized cartoon animals or a more realistic wildlife look?
answers.answer: Quiero un estilo de animales cartoon estilizado, brillante y apto para Roblox, con criaturas imponentes pero no realistas.

answers.ask: Are the six biomes one continuous world you walk between, or separate maps you load into?
answers.answer: Los seis biomas deben estar en un único mapa continuo y se podrá caminar entre ellos; la Jungla será la zona inicial.

answers.ask: Is reaching a final evolution the win condition, or is this an endless grind with no end state?
answers.answer: El objetivo es conseguir las evoluciones finales, especialmente el Dragón de la Oscuridad en las Tierras Oscuras; al lograrlo se completa la progresión principal.

scene_prompt: Crea un mapa 3D continuo de evolución animal con estilo cartoon brillante y estilizado, apto para Roblox, donde seis biomas conectados se recorren a pie. La Jungla ocupa la zona inicial y conduce por transiciones claras hacia una región nevada, un desierto, un lago, un volcán reservado para criaturas poderosas y, al extremo final del mundo, las Tierras Oscuras como destino del Dragón de la Oscuridad. Cada bioma presenta terreno, vegetación o formaciones propias, comida u orbes repartidos por el suelo, animales exclusivos, áreas de misión y un espacio abierto para un jefe gigante; coloca criaturas cada vez más imponentes hacia el volcán y las Tierras Oscuras.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is `RPG`: animal progression, hostile creatures, bosses, and a final high-tier destination define the game. No secondary genre is needed.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, a single contiguous overworld crossed on foot from the starting jungle to the final Dark Lands. The closest RPG preset is none: Open World & Survival RPG supplies a biome-scaled world but its `world-open-biomes` shape assumes separate-map routing, which contradicts the explicitly continuous six-biome map.

### Config requirements
Use `hazard-aggro` for broad, readable combat clearings in every biome, set away from the main walking route and large enough for giant bosses. Use `collectible-nodes` as visible food and glowing orb clusters scattered across each biome. Use `water-body` for the lake as a substantial traversable or boundary-defining water feature. Use `terrain-relief` for jungle rises, snowy slopes, desert dunes, volcanic cliffs, and the harsh elevated forms approaching the Dark Lands.

### Layout requirements
Place `collectible-nodes` throughout all six biomes, with distinct food or orb clusters on local terrain, along side clearings, and near but not inside boss arenas; no count is specified. Place six `spawner-npc` boss origins, one centered in each biome's dedicated open boss clearing, with the largest and most imposing origins in the volcano and Dark Lands. These markers are placed after segmentation and are not rendered as UI or mechanics.

### Layout components
Build six connected zones in a clear west-to-east progression: a lush Jungle start zone; a Snow region beyond an icy transition; a dune-filled Desert; a Lake district with shore paths and water-separated features; a steep volcanic region; and the Dark Lands at the far end as the final, ominous destination. Each zone has its own ground material, vegetation or rock formations, exclusive animal habitat, orb/food clusters, a mission area, and one open giant-boss arena. Use broad walkable transition corridors between every adjacent biome, visually blending vegetation and terrain rather than loading separate maps. Keep combat clearings off the primary circulation line. Enclose the outer perimeter with impassable cliffs, dense jungle, deep water, desert escarpments, lava fields, and dark crags. Compose the frame so the jungle foreground leads through increasingly severe terrain toward the volcano and distant Dark Lands.

### Render order
Use `topdown` first and treat it as authoritative, because the six biome connections and their continuous on-foot route must remain valid and legible before the isometric dressing is made.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by six full biomes, transition bands, boss arenas, and the long continuous progression across the world. The theme is bright, stylized Roblox cartoon wildlife: colorful, approachable environments with increasingly imposing but non-realistic creatures and darker endgame terrain. Pipeline modifiers are `tiered` for the terrain elevation and `CHECK` for the lake water surface; neither requires overhanging terrain or separate maps.
